picks.name: DJ Koze
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Spiralen EP" (PAMPA045, June 12, 2026) strips back to the understated deep house pulse of his earlier Pampa releases -- the title track carries an enigmatic female vocal over a metronomic shuffle, while AA-side "Wo's Patric?!?" has a limber groove tinged with twinkling synths.
picks.why_listen: A return to leaner, more understated territory from an artist you already play in his more maximalist mode -- good for a quieter, more hypnotic stretch of a set.

picks.name: Egoless
picks.bio: Already in your library. "OXYGENE (Egoless versions)" (February 4, 2026) reworks Jean-Michel Jarre's "Oxygene (Pt. 4)" into dub and reggae versions -- the original synth line recast for live brass, the bassline rebuilt into a 4x4 steppers groove, all instruments played live with no original samples used.
picks.why_listen: A genuinely inventive dub rework of a classic synth piece -- distinctive enough to stand out as a transition or curveball moment in a set.
